row.evidence: Fibery's pricing page lists SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning only under Enterprise ($40 per user/month billed annually, 'Everything in Pro, plus'), and its SAML SSO guide says the Enterprise plan includes SAML SSO and a SCIM endpoint for automatic provisioning/deprovisioning.
row.notes: Free (up to 10 users), Standard $12, Pro $20, Enterprise $40 per user/month billed annually; observers and guests are free. SCIM endpoint https://<workspace>.fibery.io/api/scim/v2 authenticated with an admin's personal API token (HTTP header); the token owner is never deactivated via SCIM. Only Okta (custom internal SAML app, not an OIN app) is documented; no Entra/Google/OneLogin/JumpCloud SCIM guides and no OIN listing found. SCIM deactivation preserves assignments and gives a prorated seat credit. The security page says SAML SSO is for teams on the Pro Plan, which conflicts with the pricing page and guide (Enterprise); pricing page used. The HTTP/GraphQL API can query fibery/user entities but no user-management (invite/deactivate) endpoints are documented.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Security page claims SAML SSO on Pro (see conflicts).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $40 per user/month billed annually (Chat with us)

auth.token_source: An admin's personal Fibery API token, sent in the HTTP Authorization header
auth.notes: Guide says Authentication Mode: HTTP Header with the API token; exact header scheme not stated beyond that.

operations.notes: Okta actions documented: Import New Users and Profile Updates, Push New Users, Push Profile Updates, Create Users, Deactivate Users. Update is via Okta profile push; PUT vs PATCH not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Assignments and Audit Log actions of the deactivated user are preserved; user can be reactivated with the same access.

roles.notes: Default role for JIT-provisioned users (Member or Observer) is set in SAML settings; SCIM role mapping not documented.

limitations.text: The admin whose API token is used for SCIM is never deactivated via SCIM; rotate the token first.
Only Okta (custom internal app) is documented; other IdPs via support.
JIT provisioning should be disabled when using SCIM.

user_api.notes: The HTTP commands API and GraphQL API (Public API on all plans per pricing table) can query the fibery/user database, but no invite, deactivate, role or delete operations for users are documented.

rate_limits.text: 3 requests per second per token; 7 requests per second per workspace.

okta.notes: Fibery documents a custom SAML 2.0 app ('I'm an Okta customer adding an internal app') with SCIM enabled; okta.com/integrations/fibery/ returns 404.
